subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about scaling payer cohorts for {Brand} on US paid UA. The one point worth repeating: we point MAFO at the first payer conversion through value-based bidding tied to revenue-tiered IAP events, then hold the cohort through the early banner so spend compounds into D7 and D30. At scale we have run roughly 26,000 installs a day in the 4% to 6% D7 ROAS band for US gacha RPG. Want the cohort view calibrated to your banner cadence?
angle: warm bump, restate payer conversion proof
illustrative_flags: 26,000 installs a day in the 4% to 6% D7 ROAS band (MobUpps-specific, illustrative; held as a band, not an audited result)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN gaming_midcore_hardcore: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (MAFO to first payer conversion + value-based bidding + cohort hold); one illustrative MobUpps figure (26,000/day in 4-6% D7 ROAS band); soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'; native English.
